caveat: A CANDIDATE is NOT a confirmed edge. The t-bar is relaxed, which raises the expected false-positive rate; at n trials the expected number of lucky 2.5-3.0 t-statistics grows with n. A CANDIDATE must clear forward-PAPER (>= 60 days, >= 30 trades, ECE <= 0.10, realised costs <= model x 1.5) before it trades, and its drawdown must stay under 20% with the risk overlay active.
